280599462.description:
Natural Specimens
Polished Fluorite Heart and Raw Stone Collection
Mineral, Stone, and Seashell Set
Approx. 1" to 1.75" Dimensions
Unsigned
This eclectic collection features four distinct natural elements, headlined by a hand-polished green and blue fluorite heart. The fluorite exhibits characteristic translucency and internal crystalline structures typical of the mineral. Accompanying the heart is a weathered river stone with a smooth, water-worn texture, a raw mineral specimen with granular surface detail, and a naturally aged bivalve seashell with distinct ribbing and radial symmetry.
Polished fluorite heart displays vibrant shades of teal and forest green
Rough mineral specimen features crystalline inclusions and earthy tones
Natural bivalve seashell shows classic radial symmetry and weathered white finish
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fluorite heart is polished to a high gloss with minor internal fissures typical of the mineral. The raw stones and shell show natural textures, weathering, and geological characteristics consistent with their natural and geological origins.

These insulators are perfect for display in home decor as conversation pieces or for creative upcycling projects. Their robust glass structure and timeless look make them suitable for collectors, decorators, or anyone interested in industrial relics. Large Assorted Mineral Rock Collection Smoky Quartz Amethyst Pyrite
Large assorted mineral and rock collection featuring multiple specimen types including smoky quartz, aragonite, peacock ore (bornite), amethyst, pyrite, obsidian, dendritic agate, and various other raw and tumbled stones. Collection includes compartmentalized plastic storage case with labeled mineral samples and additional clear storage container with diverse selection of rough and polished stones, crystals, and minerals. Obsidian pieces display glossy black appearance with conchoidal fracture characteristics. Other stones present variety of colors including purple, yellow, metallic, and earth tones. Condition is used but well-maintained with all pieces intact and organized. Suitable for collectors, educators, and hobbyists interested in mineralogy and geology.
